svg.title: How a contribution moves: seven steps, a Shari’ah review branch and a revise loop
svg.desc: Title: “Every change is proposed, reviewed in public and minuted before it merges”. Path of an Ummah Enhancement Proposal (UEP), modelled on BIPs, PEPs and IETF RFCs. 1, Idea: a GitHub Discussion. 2, Proposal: a UEP as a pull request. 3, Editor check: complete, well-formed. 4, Open review: public comments. Then a question: encodes a ruling? If yes, it goes to Shari’ah review (published opinion) and then to step 5. If no, it goes straight to step 5. 5, Consensus call: WG chair, minuted. If there is no consensus, it goes back to step 2 to be revised. 6, Accepted: implement and merge. 7, Final: versioned, maintained.
